turgor pressure
inside cell
concentration of external solution

options.text: It has gained water and is flaccid.
It has gained water and is turgid.

questions.questionText:
Amylase and pepsin are digestive enzymes. The shapes of their active sites are different.
What causes the difference in the shapes of their active sites?

options.text: They are produced by different parts of the digestive system.
They contain different sequences of amino acids.
They are made of different proportions of the bases A, T, C and G.

questions.questionText: Which description of an enzyme-catalysed reaction is correct?

options.text: The substrate binds to an enzyme with the same shape and a product is formed.
The product binds to an enzyme with the same shape and a substrate is formed.
The product binds to an enzyme with a complementary shape and a substrate is formed.
The substrate binds to an enzyme with a complementary shape and a product is formed.

Scientists investigate the movement of substances in a plant.
They cut a ring of tissue from the stem.
Removing the tissue removes some of the transport vessels found around the edge of the stem.

options.text: Phloem vessels have been removed and sucrose cannot move to the sink.
Phloem vessels have been removed and sucrose cannot move to the source.
Xylem vessels have been removed and minerals cannot move to the sink.
Xylem vessels have been removed and minerals cannot move to the source.

What is a response to a low concentration of glucose in the blood?

options.text: Glucagon will cause the body to convert glucose into glycogen.
Glucagon will cause the body to convert glycogen into glucose.
Insulin will cause the body to convert glucose into glycogen.

questions.questionText:
The diagram shows a strawberry plant. These plants can reproduce asexually by producing
‘plantlets’.
plantlet
Why is this method of reproduction useful to strawberry farmers?

options.text: Plantlets are produced by meiosis and are genetically different.
Plantlets are produced by meiosis and are genetically identical.
Plantlets are produced by mitosis and are genetically different.
Plantlets are produced by mitosis and are genetically identical.

questions.questionText: Which statement about human gametes is correct?

options.text: The female gamete has an acrosome and is non-motile.
The female gamete has a jelly coating and is motile.
The male gamete has a flagellum and is non-motile.
The male gamete has an acrosome and is motile.

questions.questionText: Which description of stem cells is correct?

options.text: unspecialised cells that divide by meiosis to produce daughter cells that may become specialised for specific functions
specialised cells that divide by mitosis to produce daughter cells that may become further specialised for specific functions
unspecialised cells that divide by mitosis to produce daughter cells that may become specialised for specific functions
specialised cells that divide by meiosis to produce daughter cells that may become specialised for specific functions

with a roan coat (HRHW)?

questions.questionText: What is the least sustainable method of helping to maintain a population of fish in a lake?

options.text: Only allow female fish to be caught and eaten.
Only allow fishing at certain times of the year.
Only allow fishing in certain areas of the lake.

Only allow the largest fish to be caught and eaten.
